messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to a high-angle full-body shot looking down from a front three-quarter view. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to a high-angle full-body shot looking down from a front three-quarter view. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then begins to walk forward toward the camera, briefly raising her arms before continuing to walk.","camera":"A static, high-angle full shot that keeps the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A short, colorful patterned dress with a blue V-neck and pink, purple, and yellow abstract shapes, paired with pink flat shoes.","hair_color":"Reddish-brown.","hairstyle":"Short reddish-brown hair with straight bangs and a small bun or ponytail at the back.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and light skin.","scene":"An outdoor paved area with a long shadow cast to the left, a low wall in the background, and a colorful object in the upper right corner."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's orbiting ground-level camera with a static elevated high-angle full-body view. The character remains centered, wearing the same colorful dress and pink shoes, with the same hair and general action of standing then walking forward. The background is reduced to a mostly empty paved area with a low wall and a colorful object in the upper right, rather than the detailed carnival rides and stalls seen in the source.
arguments.requested_change: Switch to a high-angle full-body shot from a front three-quarter view, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, appearance, outfit, action, environment, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the front three-quarter viewing direction exactly matches the reference image.
unexpected_changes: The detailed carnival environment from the source is largely removed, leaving a sparse paved area with only a low wall and a small colorful object visible.
